contract.description: (2023) The Formula Egg Racing series has added a new features called the 'Tachyon Rewind System' (TRS) which allows drivers to rewind time a few seconds to correct a mistake. Teams need suppliers!

missionInfos.missionLog: The center of the Galaxy does kinda look like an Egg!
Captain's Log, Star Date 20220311.1. I guess I shouldn't be so skeptical of these eggsplorers, I am on a ship powered by eggs after all.
If I had known this ship propels itself by distorting space-time, I might have reconsidered signing up.
